jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Questrade Financial Group (QFG)
, through its companies - Questrade, Questbank, Questrade Wealth Management, Community Trust Company, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, real estate services, financial services and more. We use cutting-edge technology to help Canadians become much more financially successful and secure.

At QFG, we combine human-centric collaboration with AI-driven innovation to redefine financial services. The ideal candidate will be a catalyst for change, using AI to transform and deliver unparalleled customer experiences and shaping a future where AI empowers our teams to do their best work.

Join our diverse, inclusive, and hybrid workplace to unleash your creativity and nurture your curiosity without limits. If you share this sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?

Health & wellbeing resources and programs
Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work-life balance
Competitive compensation and benefits packages
Work-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office
Career growth and development opportunities
Opportunities to contribute to community causes
Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment

This job posting is for an existing vacancy

We’re looking for our next Director, FP&A. Could It Be You?

The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is a key leadership role within the Finance team, designed to deliver insightful financial information and strategic analysis to the Executive Team and Board of Directors. Contributing directly to the success of Questbank and Questrade Financial Group, this role leads the business case and investment process, budget and forecast functions, and comprehensive management reporting. The Director plays a pivotal role in tracking headcount investments and overall financial performance while leading precise, fact-based upfront analysis for upwards of $100MM in new yearly initiatives, ensuring alignment with both short- and long-term corporate strategic objectives.

Need more details? Keep reading…

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Leading the development, monitoring, and reporting for all business cases within the organization. Oversee precise and fact-based upfront analysis, ongoing monitoring, and reporting to the executive team for upwards of $100MM in new initiatives annually to ensure success.
Directing and driving the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget and monthly rolling forecasts. Collaborate closely with division leaders to ensure all assumptions are tested and vetted properly, ownership exists at the division level, and consensus is gained to align on organizational goals.
Leading the comprehensive monthly review of consolidated financials against the budget. Provide in-depth analysis to division leaders and the executive team focusing on KPIs, key ratios, and delivering value-added commentary on next steps to keep the company on track for its long-term strategic goals.
Driving rigorous financial modeling for all acquisitions and special projects. Work closely with corporate development to ensure detailed and accurate models covering organic growth, acquisition-related growth, integration economics, income statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and covenants, enabling Senior Management to make informed decisions.
Being responsible for all management reporting to division leads, the executive team, and the board (including Management Reports, Journey Reports, business KPIs, key ratios, corporate scorecards, and MD&A) against the budget, forecast, prior year, prior month, and the 5-year plan. Ensure consistency across corporate and business unit reporting.
Serving as the primary FP&A system lead, driving continuous improvement and automation in financial processes, reporting frameworks, and data integrity.
Partnering with senior leadership, Treasury, and Risk Management to ensure financial reporting consistency, liquidity tracking, and holistic strategic decision-making support.
Structuring, managing, and mentoring the FP&A team to align with corporate requirements. Set clear performance objectives, provide regular feedback, and foster a high-performance culture.

So are YOU our next Director, FP&A? You are if you…

Have a Post-secondary degree/diploma in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
Have a completed CPA or equivalent accounting designation
Have 10+ years of experience in the financial industry
Have 5+ years of experience in a similar FP&A role
Have 5+ years in a management role
Have advanced financial modeling, budgeting and analytical skills.

Additional Kudos If You…

Have experience in financial services, wealth management, or banking (highly beneficial for Questbank).
Have experience with enterprise FP&A and ERP systems such as NetSuite or Oracle EPBCS (Hyperion)

Sounds like you? Click below to apply!

At Questrade Financial Group of Companies, with multiple office locations around the world, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and accessible work environment. This is an environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Here, the unique skills and experience you bring will be valued. You will be supported and motivated, so that you can harness your unlimited potential. Our team reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and operate in. Having a collaborative and diverse team helps us push boundaries to bring the future of fintech into existence—not only for the benefit of our customers, but for those who build their career with us.

jobs.title: Director, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Company Description

For 100 years, Reitmans (Canada) Limited (RCL) has defined the Canadian retail fashion landscape with its three iconic brands, Reitmans, RW&CO. and PENN. Penningtons. We're excited about what we’ll build together next. 

Our vision is to empower Canadians to live confidently, and our mission is to create collections of uncompromising style and quality for all.

We believe great people do their best work alongside other great people. Here, you’ll have a voice, be challenged to grow and be part of a team driven by curiosity, bold thinking and ownership.

Come raise the bar of Canadian fashion with us.

Job Description

The Director, Data & Analytics leads the development and execution of RCL’s data and analytics strategy, enabling actionable insights to enhance customer engagement and overall business performance. The Director will champion a data-driven culture by ensuring accurate and consistent digital and ecommerce measurement, developing meaningful performance frameworks, and leveraging advanced analytics, experimentation, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for growth and optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the enterprise Data & Analytics strategy and roadmap, establishing a clear vision, priorities, and multi-year roadmap for data, analytics, and AI capabilities aligned to RCL’s broader business strategy and growth objectives
Develop the organization’s data and AI maturity, fostering data literacy, enabling self-service analytics where appropriate, and building a culture in which teams across the enterprise use data and AI confidently and responsibly to inform decisions
Enable trusted, actionable business insights by establishing consistent metrics, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and analytical methodologies that enable leaders to understand performance and make informed decisions
Build excellent partnerships with leaders across the Digital, eComm, Retail, Merchandising, Marketing and Finance teams, to identify opportunities where data and analytics can improve customer experience, profitability, and operational performance
Strengthen digital and ecommerce analytics accuracy, ensuring robust measurement, tagging, tracking, attribution, and data quality across digital channels and ecommerce platforms to provide a reliable view of customer behaviour, channel performance, conversion, and the overall digital customer journey
Improve marketing and channel measurement, developing sophisticated approaches to attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition, retention, media effectiveness, and ROI to optimize investment across channels
Develop predictive and advanced analytics capabilities, including forecasting, segmentation, propensity modelling, experimentation, and AI/ML use cases that generate measurable business value
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations, effectively communicating insights and implications to executive and non-technical audiences
Establish enterprise-wide data governance and standards across RCL, including data definitions, quality standards, ownership, stewardship, accessibility, privacy, and governance practices that ensure data is trusted, consistent, secure, and fit for purpose across brands and functions.
Partner with Technology on data architecture and platforms, helping define the enterprise data ecosystem, architecture, platforms, infrastructure, and tooling required to enable scalable analytics, AI, reporting, and business intelligence capabilities
Build a high-performing analytics function, developing talent, ways of working, governance, and capabilities that enable the organization to become increasingly data-driven.
Champion a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement, using analytics, testing, and evidence-based learning to identify what works, scale successful initiatives, and improve business outcomes
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and methodology in data science and AI to bring the best innovation to RCL

Qualifications

10+ years of demonstrated experience in advanced analytics, data science and/or data engineering, preferably in retail, with at least 3 years in a leadership role
Bachelors degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering or Mathematics. MBA or equivalent experience preferred
Proven ability and experience leading teams to analyze customer data for actionable business insight
Strong SQL skills for querying relational databases
Deep expertise in Google Analytics and web analytics implementation
Experience using and implementing visualization tools like Tableau, MicroStrategy or Power BI
Experience with common machine learning libraries in R, Python, Spark is an asset
Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail
Strong balance between the science of analytics, and the storytelling required to appropriately interpret business insights: skilled at turning complex analysis into simple conclusions and recommendations
Technical data science & analytics leadership: ability and desire to coach the team to build technical skills

Additional Information

What Sets Us Apart:

Ultimate Flexibility*: Enjoy a hybrid work environment that ensures the perfect balance between work and personal life.
Well-Being First: Access a comprehensive benefits program designed to take care of you.
Flexible Time Off*: Paid leave, sick days, and vacation time to recharge and spend quality time with loved ones.
Exclusive Discounts*: Enjoy 50% off regular-priced items from PENN. Penningtons, Reitmans, and RW&CO.
Referral Rewards*: Refer your professional network and earn a bonus for helping us grow our talented team
Growth opportunities*: Annual bonuses, career advancement, and tuition reimbursement to help you reach your professional goals.
Certain conditions apply

Total rewards are aligned with your employment status, offering different perks depending on whether you're full-time, part-time, or under contract.

jobs.description:
Join a financial services firm where your contributions are valued. Edward Jones is a Fortune 500¹ company where people come first. With over 9 million clients and 20,000 financial advisors across the U.S. and Canada, we’re proud to be privately-owned, placing the focus on our clients rather than shareholder returns.

Behind everything we do is our purpose: We partner for positive impact to improve the lives of our clients and colleagues, and together, better our communities and society. We are an innovative, flexible, and inclusive organization that attracts, develops, and inspires performance excellence and a sense of belonging.

People are at the center of our partnership. Edward Jones associates are seen, heard, respected, and supported. This is what we believe makes us the best place to start or build your career.

View our Purpose, Inclusion and Citizenship Report.

Canada Learning is responsible for building new capabilities critical to our firm's strategy at speed and scale, ensuring our home-office associates and branch team members are reskilled and upskilled to deliver industry-leading comprehensive planning and advice. Canada Learning operates as a durable team that serves Canadian specific priorities and Canadian specific enduring programs.

The Leader, Learning and Performance Strateg y
is accountable to lead development and execution of learning strategies and roadmaps for several portfolios ensuring integration and alignment with firm business needs, enterprise strategy and regulatory environment. Execute strategic priorities and lead cross-functional teams to deliver business impact through strategically sequenced, continuous learning and performance initiatives that optimize performance and sustain targeted behavior change. In this role, you will be responsible for the strategic vision and long-term development of learning and performance professionals in service to Learning value delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Ongoing responsibility to consult and collaborate with stakeholders to drive learning strategy and framework for professional development programs at all levels that build skills and capability, and support current and future organizational talent needs
Lead functional execution of learning intake to assess learning needs and resources from across the organization, including prioritized workstreams, region consultation and branch advisory.
Employ a performance consulting approach to identify and address performance gaps, participate and represent learning in the strategic business plan development, ongoing business meetings and in decisions with stakeholders.
Establish trusted partnerships as a consultant to business and functional leaders throughout the organization, employing diplomacy, objectivity, and learning sciences to strategize, influence, prioritize, plan, and deliver learning and performance experiences that improve overall firm performance
Collaborate with and influence business, providing well-informed and strategically critical inputs into firm strategic planning and identifying opportunities for learning and performance to yield measurable business outcomes
Lead the establishment and ongoing monitoring of learning and performance measures and outcomes across the Canada business segment, analyzing trends to adjust learning strategy and design as needed
Lead a team of learning and performance professionals to deliver results (people and process leadership) via strategy, influence, prioritization, planning, and delivery of learning and performance experiences that improve overall firm performance
In alignment with Learning Strategy, build, guide, and lead a team of learning and performance associates to design and deliver high impact talent development learning experiences that yield needed and sustained performance results
While leading in a matrixed environment, facilitate associates' development of strategy, design, and delivery capabilities through formal development plans, professional development opportunities, on-the-job coaching, and performance support.
Establish a culture of continuous learning within Learning, leading internal talent development, change management, and growth mindset initiatives to increase associate engagement and enable rapid capability building
Collaborate with other leaders in Learning and Canada Business Unit to strategize, plan, and execute on operations. Use external research and value delivery plans to inform capability strategy; use development needs and progress to inform project resourcing and opportunities
Propose and collaborate on developing new or modifying existing firm policies to propel our ability to develop differentiated skills through our associate population
At times, serve as a learning experience designer to design, develop, curate, and deliver impactful, fit-to-purpose learning and development initiatives that achieve business outcomes while remaining responsive to individual development goals and building learners' intrinsic motivation to continuously learn and improve.
Advocates and champions learning within the business and proactively contributes to creating an organizationally integrated function that is scalable, flexible, efficient, and effective

Skills/Requirements

Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Learning & Development, Education, Organizational Psychology, Human Capital Management, or related field
5+ years in corporate learning, performance consultation, or similar role
3+ years of experience leading learning and performance initiatives that achieve business objectives
5+ years of people leadership experience with proven experience successfully leading associates in a matrixed environment, providing coaching and development to a variety of levels
Adult Education Certification
Brinkerhoff Architect Certification required within first 12 months
Financial Services Industry experience preferred
Financial Services Professional Designation(s) preferred. (CFP, QAFP, PFA, CIWM, etc.)
Occasional travel could be required not to exceed 25% of the time

Skills, Knowledge, And Abilities

Proven ability to design and curate high-performance learning journeys
Proven ability to successfully manage multiple projects and processes in a dynamic, matrix environment with a complex map of stakeholders
Knowledge of change management
Proven ability to establish trusted partnerships as a consultant to colleagues and senior leaders, employing objectivity and learning sciences to influence leadership decisions and achieve outcomes
Proven experience using Design Thinking and User Experience Research Principles and Methodologies to develop learning and performance strategies
Knowledge of Learning Sciences, Instructional Design, and Modern Learning Experience Tools and Methodologies
Proven ability to identify opportunities for learning and performance professional development that yields measurable business outcomes
Proven ability to establish and monitor learning and performance measures, analyzing trends to adjust learning strategy and design as needed
Applied understanding of Systems Thinking, Root Cause Analysis, and Problem-Solving Methodologies to recommend learning solutions to complex performance challenges
Bilingual (Fluency in English/French) is an asset

jobs.description:
Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours

37.5

Line Of Business

Marketing

Pay Details

$155,000 - $215,000 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

Reporting to the Vice President, Growth Marketing, the Associate Vice President, Digital Performance Marketing leads the strategy, execution, optimization and performance of the digital marketing practice. The role provides enterprise and business leadership for digital marketing, connecting marketing strategy to measurable client and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities Include

Digital Performance Marketing Strategy & Execution – Set and direct digital marketing strategy; establish channel roles, investment principles and execution standards aligned to business priorities.
Digital Marketing Leadership & Standards – Provide leadership across digital marketing channels, embed enterprise best practices and measurement standards, and build the digital marketing capabilities required to create competitive advantage.
Generative AI & LLM Visibility Strategy – Establish and execute TD’s enterprise Generative Engine Optimization and AI search visibility framework, including standards for how products, brand and advisory content are structured and represented within AI-assisted discovery experiences.
Enterprise SEO & Owned Content Discovery – Lead organic search and owned content visibility across business segments; unify specialist teams under one technical mandate and establish shared priorities, methods and performance measures.
Technical Search Architecture – Partner with Marketing Technology, Digital Experience, Content, Data and Technology teams to improve structured data, schema markup, site taxonomy, crawlability, indexing and domain authority.
Content Signals & Authority – Define enterprise standards that strengthen content quality, relevance, provenance and authority for both search engines and AI systems while supporting clear, accurate customer information.
Agency, Platform & Vendor Leadership – Lead relationships with agencies, media and technology platforms, and other vendors as extensions of the team, with clear expectations for performance, transparency, controls, innovation and value realization.
Planning, Investment & Delivery – Translate marketing strategies and annual plans into executable digital programs with clear targets, offers, timelines and budgets; steward investment and delivery to improve efficiency/effectiveness and achieve on-budget outcomes.
Emerging Discovery Intelligence – Monitor changes in search behaviour, answer engines, LLMs and digital discovery ecosystems; translate external shifts into actionable enterprise growth, content and experience strategies.
Performance Management & Executive Advisory – Provide ongoing insight into digital marketing performance relative to plan, forecast, prior year and competitive benchmarks; translate results and channel dynamics into clear decisions, trade-offs and actions for senior leaders.
Governance & Risk – Establish controls, measurement and escalation practices for search visibility, content accuracy, brand representation, privacy and regulatory considerations across evolving discovery platforms.
Integrated Marketing & Business Planning – Partner with business, segment, portfolio, channel and Integrated Marketing Planning leaders to translate priorities into digital strategies, plans, and investment choices.
Data, Technology, Analytics & Measurement – Work with Marketing Technology, Data and AI Enablement, analytics, privacy, risk and technology partners to strengthen audience activation, personalization, measurement, attribution and responsible use of data and AI.
People Leadership & Ways of Working – Build and develop a high-performing digital marketing organization, strengthen succession and functional expertise, and evolve collaborative, cross-functional ways of working, including agile principles where appropriate.

Education & Experience

12+ years of progressive experience in digital performance marketing, digital discovery, content platforms, digital experience, marketing technology and/or technical digital transformation.
Strong understanding of the digital marketing ecosystem spanning paid, owned and earned digital channels, including search, digital advertising, social media, onsite experiences, content, personalized messaging, media strategy, measurement and attribution.
Deep expertise of AI-leading digital marketing practices, including deep technical mastery of modern SEO/GEO, semantic search architecture, content indexing, structured data, schema, taxonomy and domain authority.
Proven ability to lead enterprise-scale digital transformation in a regulated environment while balancing technical depth, customer outcomes and risk requirements.
Executive-level influencing and advisory capability, with the ability to translate complex digital marketing dynamics into clear decisions and trade-offs.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop senior leaders and specialized teams across multiple business portfolios.
Post-secondary degree in marketing, business, analytics, technology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. Lead functional execution of learning intake to assess learning needs and resources from across the organization, including prioritized workstreams, region consultation and branch advisory.

In alignment with Learning Strategy, build, guide, and lead a team of learning and performance associates to design and deliver high impact talent development learning experiences that yield needed and sustained performance results

Collaborate with other leaders in Learning and Canada Business Unit to strategize, plan, and execute on operations. Use external research and value delivery plans to inform capability strategy; use development needs and progress to inform project resourcing and opportunities
Propose and collaborate on developing new or modifying existing firm policies to propel our ability to develop differentiated skills through our associate population
At times, serve as a learning experience designer to design, develop, curate, and deliver impactful, fit-to-purpose learning and development initiatives that achieve business outcomes while remaining responsive to individual development goals and building learners' intrinsic motivation to continuously learn and improve.
Advocates and champions learning within the business and proactively contributes to creating an organizationally integrated function that is scalable, flexible, efficient, and effective

Skills, Knowledge, And Abilities

new_jobs.description:
Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours

37.5

Line Of Business

Marketing

Pay Details

$155,000 - $215,000 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

Reporting to the Vice President, Growth Marketing, the Associate Vice President, Digital Performance Marketing leads the strategy, execution, optimization and performance of the digital marketing practice. The role provides enterprise and business leadership for digital marketing, connecting marketing strategy to measurable client and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities Include

Digital Performance Marketing Strategy & Execution – Set and direct digital marketing strategy; establish channel roles, investment principles and execution standards aligned to business priorities.
Digital Marketing Leadership & Standards – Provide leadership across digital marketing channels, embed enterprise best practices and measurement standards, and build the digital marketing capabilities required to create competitive advantage.
Generative AI & LLM Visibility Strategy – Establish and execute TD’s enterprise Generative Engine Optimization and AI search visibility framework, including standards for how products, brand and advisory content are structured and represented within AI-assisted discovery experiences.
Enterprise SEO & Owned Content Discovery – Lead organic search and owned content visibility across business segments; unify specialist teams under one technical mandate and establish shared priorities, methods and performance measures.
Technical Search Architecture – Partner with Marketing Technology, Digital Experience, Content, Data and Technology teams to improve structured data, schema markup, site taxonomy, crawlability, indexing and domain authority.
Content Signals & Authority – Define enterprise standards that strengthen content quality, relevance, provenance and authority for both search engines and AI systems while supporting clear, accurate customer information.
Agency, Platform & Vendor Leadership – Lead relationships with agencies, media and technology platforms, and other vendors as extensions of the team, with clear expectations for performance, transparency, controls, innovation and value realization.
Planning, Investment & Delivery – Translate marketing strategies and annual plans into executable digital programs with clear targets, offers, timelines and budgets; steward investment and delivery to improve efficiency/effectiveness and achieve on-budget outcomes.
Emerging Discovery Intelligence – Monitor changes in search behaviour, answer engines, LLMs and digital discovery ecosystems; translate external shifts into actionable enterprise growth, content and experience strategies.
Performance Management & Executive Advisory – Provide ongoing insight into digital marketing performance relative to plan, forecast, prior year and competitive benchmarks; translate results and channel dynamics into clear decisions, trade-offs and actions for senior leaders.
Governance & Risk – Establish controls, measurement and escalation practices for search visibility, content accuracy, brand representation, privacy and regulatory considerations across evolving discovery platforms.
Integrated Marketing & Business Planning – Partner with business, segment, portfolio, channel and Integrated Marketing Planning leaders to translate priorities into digital strategies, plans, and investment choices.
Data, Technology, Analytics & Measurement – Work with Marketing Technology, Data and AI Enablement, analytics, privacy, risk and technology partners to strengthen audience activation, personalization, measurement, attribution and responsible use of data and AI.
People Leadership & Ways of Working – Build and develop a high-performing digital marketing organization, strengthen succession and functional expertise, and evolve collaborative, cross-functional ways of working, including agile principles where appropriate.

Education & Experience

12+ years of progressive experience in digital performance marketing, digital discovery, content platforms, digital experience, marketing technology and/or technical digital transformation.
Strong understanding of the digital marketing ecosystem spanning paid, owned and earned digital channels, including search, digital advertising, social media, onsite experiences, content, personalized messaging, media strategy, measurement and attribution.
Deep expertise of AI-leading digital marketing practices, including deep technical mastery of modern SEO/GEO, semantic search architecture, content indexing, structured data, schema, taxonomy and domain authority.
Proven ability to lead enterprise-scale digital transformation in a regulated environment while balancing technical depth, customer outcomes and risk requirements.
Executive-level influencing and advisory capability, with the ability to translate complex digital marketing dynamics into clear decisions and trade-offs.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop senior leaders and specialized teams across multiple business portfolios.
Post-secondary degree in marketing, business, analytics, technology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Director, Finance (CSM)

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
